_note: Canonical provenance classes. provenance_class is derived from the legacy free-text `provenance` string by the first matching rule below; the original string is kept untouched. A string no rule matches is reported and mapped to `unknown`, never guessed.

values.ours: measured by this lab with its own instruments (including derived rows)
values.ours-bench: measured by this lab through silicon-ledger-bench (carries a report fingerprint)
values.third-party: number published or measured by someone else, reproduced here as a reference
values.mixed: one row that combines an external number with our own observation
